beats.storyAction: An empty forest path establishes the destination and suspicious box before the Adventurer arrives.
beats.cameraMotivation: Show the path, layered forest depth, foreground foliage and the box as the story destination.

beats.storyAction: The Adventurer enters from outside frame and walks along the forest path.
beats.cameraMotivation: Track the arrival and preserve forward screen direction toward the box.

beats.storyAction: The Adventurer stops, notices the suspicious box and turns attention toward it.
beats.cameraMotivation: Reveal the box as the cause of the stop while keeping the Adventurer in spatial context.

beats.storyAction: The Adventurer approaches carefully without losing sight of the box.
beats.cameraMotivation: Keep both character and box visible as their distance closes.

beats.storyAction: The Adventurer reaches toward the box; contact triggers a lid pop, box shake and leaf-particle burst.
beats.cameraMotivation: Show the hand-to-prop relationship and the visible consequence in the same composition.

beats.storyAction: The box moves and the Adventurer recoils in surprise.
beats.cameraMotivation: Prioritize readable body acting because the character has no facial controls.

beats.storyAction: Still facing the box, the Adventurer steps backward to create distance.
beats.cameraMotivation: Show backward displacement and preserve the box as the threat.

beats.storyAction: The Adventurer points toward the suspicious box as a warning.
beats.cameraMotivation: Align the authored forward-pointing pose with the box rather than presenting an isolated gesture.

beats.storyAction: The Adventurer turns away and exits quickly beyond the frame.
beats.cameraMotivation: Follow briefly, then let the character leave so the unresolved box remains behind.

beats.storyAction: The camera returns to the box; its lid twitches while leaves drift through the quiet forest.
beats.cameraMotivation: End on the story question rather than an empty stage or character pose.
